name: Atlassian (Jira & Confluence)
description: Search and edit Jira issues and Confluence pages through the Atlassian Remote MCP Server.

verification.notes: Atlassian's docs now point to the v2 endpoint (v1 clients are retired on 2027-03-01). Live check: 401 + RFC 9728 metadata; the authorization server supports CIMD and dynamic client registration. An Atlassian API token also works as a bearer token.
